title: NFL, NFLPA are "working together" to review Jalen Hurts situation

sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: NFL, NFLPA are "working together" to review Jalen Hurts situation
sources.description: As another full Sunday of football approaches, there's a new development in the situation regarding Eagles quarterback Jalen Hurts, who is likely out for the rest of the year after a "superficial" blood clot became a deep vein thrombosis and blood clots in each lung.
